Come, cousin Angelo; In this I'll be impartial; be you judge Of your own cause. Is this the witness, friar? First, let her show her face, and after speak."

In this play, Duke Vincentio is the one who orchestrates the proceedings while disguised as a friar, observing and managing the situation involving Angelo. The quote perfectly matches the voice of the controlling figure (Vincentio) addressing the participants in the court/interrogation scene.

6.  **Conclusion:** The speaker is DUKE VINCENTIO.
